catalogue_source: The canonical FI-001 to FI-062 catalogue file is not in this repository. web/tracepayvisiondev.md is absent. Untitled ids are listed without reconstructed names or definitions.

covered_by_another_item.name: Duplicate Charges
covered_by_another_item.reason: Same-day duplicate charges are detected as duplicate_payment_leak with finding_focus duplicate_merchant_payment. There is no separate duplicate-charge detector.

deferred.name: Impulse Spending Pattern
deferred.reason: A shopping/spending increase does not prove impulse intent, and the current data model contains no reliable impulse-intent signal.

deferred.name: Merchant Billing Errors
deferred.reason: The current data model lacks the evidence required to decide that a merchant billed incorrectly.

deferred.name: Currency Conversion Markup
deferred.reason: The current data model lacks a separate currency-conversion markup signal.

deferred.name: Dynamic Currency Conversion
deferred.reason: The current data model lacks a dynamic currency conversion signal.

deferred.name: Credit Utilisation Warning
deferred.reason: The current data model lacks a credit-limit or utilisation signal.

deferred.name: Insurance Overlap
deferred.reason: The current data model lacks evidence that two insurance products cover the same risk.

deferred.name: Unused Insurance Products
deferred.reason: The current data model lacks evidence that an insurance product is unused.

deferred.name: Missing Refund Investigation
deferred.reason: The current data model lacks a refund-expected signal.

deferred.name: Cashback Not Received
deferred.reason: The current data model lacks an expected-cashback signal.

deferred.name: Incorrect Merchant Charge
deferred.reason: The current data model lacks a reference charge that would show a merchant amount was incorrect.

deferred.name: Better Account Recommendation
deferred.reason: The current data model lacks account-product and fee-schedule evidence for a better-account comparison.

deferred.name: Digital Banking Migration Opportunity
deferred.reason: The current data model lacks evidence that a digital alternative exists for this account.

deferred.name: Payment Method Optimisation
deferred.reason: The current data model lacks evidence that a cheaper payment method was available.

deferred.name: Banking Cost Benchmark
deferred.reason: The current data model lacks an external banking-cost benchmark.
